description:
Use this when the user wants to see their brand kit: "what is in my brand kit", "which logo and colors do I
        use", "what are my brand fonts". Returns the logos (logo_id and name), the brand colors, the fonts, the intro and
        outro videos and the brand music kept in RipClip under Media > Brand kit; empty says it has nothing yet.
        Not for: changing it (set_brand_kit), putting it on clips (apply_brand_kit) or a clip's current look
        (preview_frame). Free and read only. Next: set_brand_kit to fill it, or apply_brand_kit.
name: get_brand_kit
title: Show the brand kit
